subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/figure-it-out.md
why: Owner rulings of 2026-11-05 §E (figure-it-out: a playbook, adopted whole) and §G (batch P1 as recommended; guide exceptions O-05, C-14, C-12 confirmed) (scratchpad/mvp-stack/13/owner-rulings-2026-11-05.md:39, :72); build order and the overlap review deferred to cr-r2pa.3.4, 2026-11-12 (scratchpad/mvp-stack/59/decisions.md), plan 62. New playbook for a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change or long work a person reviews after stepping away, which the person asks the agent to work out and carry through and no narrower playbook fits. Steps: (1) Principles, the router's principle lines first; (2) Frame, a falsifiable predicate, quantified scope, rigor biased high, shown to the person; (3) Design, landable units or a named group, riskiest unknown first, scaffold and check first, codebase-design on one-way doors, fan-out across seams with a worktree each, the design written down and its steps added as todos; (4) Trail, one decision-trail call open through step 6; (5) Run, a hypothesis per unit, smallest change, keep or revert, judged delegated units, bounded gate-gaming retry, three-value verdicts; (6) Hand back, the whole checked on the real product and logged before the trail's audit and review, then the reply.
